subject: U-442 round 3 FINAL: NO-GO published and reports pushed
body: Aggregated all three axes without reranking, published the 324-word round-3 NO-GO on PR #485 after the egress receipt, and pushed report-only commit cb5a95c4e735fc3c3a1363cc0c9061a223a84988 on u-442. Five Required findings remain (S3-R1, R3-STD-1, R3-T1, R3-T2, R3-T3), while the clean-clone 1733-test suite, validator, and floor guard with six waived matches passed at reviewed SHA f0fe3fc0b0c0a237998090c19a9a4bb1f35f5bc5. The reports are durable and the worktree is clean; the coordinator must park U-442 with a gate naming those stickers, with no merge or fourth autonomous round.
